model.description: R-C1: the sprint pin (which-sprint pointer + the three slots current/last-completed/next-backlog) is a GENERATED view COMPUTED from each sprint's tasks — it cannot be hand-set and cannot drift. Replaces the brittle name matcher (CurrentSprint.ts:202 /\d+/ + .includes) and the hand-set Sprint.status. NUMBER-KEYED throughout. Rolls up R-C5 deriveStatusEnum per sprint (single-source). Design design-rc1-pin-resolver.md.
